sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/SANDAI/Sandai Farm - Rates African Footprints 24,25,26.xlsx
currency: EUR (non-resident); KES with a Euro-equivalent column shown for resident/self-catering rates
notes: IMPORTANT: Despite the filename mentioning '24,25,26', the only rate table's own header explicitly reads 'African Footprints Rates 2024 - June 25' - i.e. the actual validity window stated in the document is 1 Jan 2024 through June 2025, NOT 2026. This file sits in the '2026 CONTRACT RATES' folder tree but contains NO current 2026 rate card. Flagged prominently: do NOT use these figures for a live 2026 quote without confirming a fresh rate card with the property first.
Rates quoted per person per day (full board, double room basis) for non-residents in EUR; residents and self-catering cottages in KES with a separate EUR-equivalent column.
Commission column present per line item: 20% for non-resident full-board rates, 10% for resident/self-catering rates.
seasonDefinition: High Season: 15 Dec-31 Mar and 15 Jun-31 Oct, plus 1 week before/after Easter. Plus 20% surcharge on Christmas/New Year (24 Dec-1 Jan).

childPolicy.raw: Up to 4 years: free. 4-12 years: half rate.

policies.balancePayment: Due 30 days before booking commencement; full payment required if booked within 30 days of start
policies.cancellation: 45-59 days before tour start: 50% of booking cost; less than 45 days: 100% of booking cost
policies.confidenceNote: All figures and policies in this file are historical/expired reference only per the top-level note - a fresh 2026 rate card must be obtained from the property before quoting.
